verdict.rationale: Reflect has no native automation builder or autonomous AI agent. Background automation is only possible through third-party Zapier [reflect-docs-47] or user-built clients on the limited append-only OAuth API [reflect-docs-17][reflect-supp-openpm-spec]. Built-in background behavior is limited to fixed syncs and processes such as Kindle sync and audio transcription [reflect-docs-10][reflect-docs-51], not user-defined automations. Missing for 10: native user-configurable automations/triggers, autonomous AI agent workflows, scheduling, documented Zapier triggers/actions, and hands-on corroboration.
